mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 9.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's predictive power (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and INDPRO falling) fails to predict negative returns (SPX 60-day returns not significantly negative in triggered instances, t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), or the regime-specific signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of non-farm payroll jobs (PAYEMS) declines by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS declines by >100k (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 90.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening housing market, which is a key component of consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) fails to predict negative returns (SPX 60-day returns not significantly negative in triggered instances, t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).
